answer: When an operator resizes a window, the sizes it settles on and the speed of the resize form a pattern tied to their screen and habits. A farm running headless browsers resizes to identical dimensions every time, so the network checks viewport resize behaviour against the account's history and across accounts. The design treats each session as a shale: small alone, decisive in aggregate. Whether the proof comes from a cipher or a plume, the verification step is identical and public.
